summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its annual general meeting of shareholders held June 25, 2026. All matters were approved: fixing the board at eight directors, election of eight nominees, reappointment of KPMG LLP as auditor, and approval of unallocated entitlements under the Share Unit Plan. 66.81% of shares were represented. This is a routine reporting of an annual meeting with no special-situation elements. No forced management changes, M&A, or other extraordinary event occurred.
